common_assumptions: Input content conforms to expected format without pre-validation
Prior session and file state persists unchanged between tool calls
Tool outputs are complete and not paginated or truncated
Successful build or typecheck implies correct runtime behavior
Single-pass rule application covers all edge cases in style enforcement tasks
strength_patterns: Targeted read-modify-verify cycles demonstrate systematic grounding before committing edits in complex chains
Complex tasks decompose cleanly into scout-modify-test sequences with intermediate tool-based verification
Constrained single-step tasks execute with strict rule adherence and zero scope creep
weakness_patterns: Fixation loops where a single file is edited 15 or more times without a convergence check before continuing
Premature termination visible in multiple zero-step chains on non-trivial tasks suggesting early abandonment before output
Single-pass execution on verification-requiring tasks with no runtime exercise to confirm correctness
